item.title: Orlando Weather: Surviving the Dangerous Heat and Daily Storms
item.description:
What if the temperature on your phone was actually lying to you — and the real number felt 15 degrees hotter? That’s exactly what’s happening across Central Florida right now.

Orlando weather has entered one of its most punishing stretches of the summer, with “feels-like” temperatures pushing into the 110s and heat advisories blanketing the entire region. And just when you think the sky might offer relief, afternoon storms roll in almost daily.

item.title: Heat Advisory Alert: Essential Safety Guide for 2026
item.description:
Here’s a fact that should stop you cold: last summer was the hottest ever recorded for the entire planet. And in 2026, the heat isn’t backing down.

As of this week, a heat advisory is in effect across large stretches of the United States — from Southern California and Denver to the Twin Cities and Central Florida. Millions of Americans are being told to stay out of the sun and check on their neighbors.
